features.note: Not built: the reader draws every page in the system face and the Display panel has no family row. The unwired font model was removed; a serif or sans face and a family setting in store::Settings are still needed, then the page layout measures with that face.

Tested headless in books/library_tests.rs (line_spacing_margins_and_justification_lay_the_pages_out_again_and_persist, only_lines_inside_a_paragraph_are_stretched_when_justified) and books/layout.rs (line_spacing_changes_how_many_lines_fit_a_page). Gap: not verified on Midget.

File > Print sends a PDF as it is, and an EPUB as its headings and paragraphs through the print service.
